instructions:
1. Stand to one side of a low box in an athletic stance, knees soft.
2. Step the lead foot onto the box, then quickly bring the trailing foot up.
3. Step down on the far side and keep moving laterally as fast as you can.
4. Reverse direction and run back across the box.
5. Stay low and keep your feet light and quick.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest up and weight on the balls of your feet.
2. Drive off the outside leg to change direction sharply.
3. Pump your arms to help maintain rhythm and speed.
4. Keep knees bent to absorb impact and protect joints.
name: Low box lateral Runner

instructions:
1. Stand facing a low box in an athletic stance, knees soft.
2. Tap one foot lightly on top of the box, then quickly switch to the other foot.
3. Alternate feet as fast as possible, staying on the balls of your feet.
4. Keep your torso upright and core braced.
5. Continue for the set duration or count.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Stay light on your toes and minimise ground contact time.
2. Keep knees bent and hips low throughout.
3. Drive your arms to match the leg cadence.
4. Brace your core to stay balanced and centred.
name: Low box quick feet

instructions:
1. Lie face down on a bench with your head and neck hanging off the edge.
2. Hold a light weight plate against the back of your head with both hands.
3. Lower your chin toward your chest under control.
4. Extend your neck to raise the back of your head toward the ceiling.
5. Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and never jerk the neck.
2. Use a towel between the plate and your head for comfort.
3. Keep the range of motion controlled and pain-free.
4. Start with very light weight and progress gradually.
name: Lying Neck Extension_Female

instructions:
1. Lie on your back on a bench with your head and neck hanging off the edge.
2. Hold a light weight plate against your forehead with both hands.
3. Lower your head back under control to extend the neck.
4. Curl your neck forward, bringing your chin toward your chest.
5. Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and keep the motion smooth.
2. Place a towel between the plate and your forehead for comfort.
3. Keep the range of motion controlled and pain-free.
4. Start with very light weight and build up gradually.
name: Lying Neck Curls

instructions:
1. Stand on the centre of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Hold a handle in each hand with palms facing inward, arms at your sides.
3. Curl one hand toward your shoulder, keeping the elbow tucked.
4. Lower under control to the start.
5. Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your wrists straight and palms facing each other throughout.
2. Keep elbows pinned to your sides and avoid swinging.
3. Control the band on the way down to keep tension.
4. Squeeze at the top before lowering.
name: Alternating biceps hammer curl resistance band
